usedFor: Solve CRM holds contacts, and “New Tagged Contact” can set up a meeting in Calendly.

bestTemplate.name: “New Tagged Contact” in Solve CRM, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A tag you apply to a contact starts a one-time meeting, so only chosen contacts get a call.

watchOut: “New Tagged Contact” in Solve CRM is polling, so the meeting appears after a scheduled check.
